note: golden-02.html is a delivery-address form and the example for the criteria graded by which branch of their condition fired. The required House number field beside a street field is severity 3, because an address with no number cannot be entered, and the required County field is the lesser branch at 2 (FORMS-ADDRESS-FORMAT). Autocomplete switched off on the postcode is 3, address data, while the city and county fields that only lack a token are 2 (FORMS-AUTOCOMPLETE, the ruled scale). The phone pattern accepts digits only and rejects a number written with spaces or a leading plus (FORMS-FORMAT-TOLERANCE, 3). That required phone field gives no reason while the form also asks for an email address, so it is the greater branch at 3 (FORMS-PHONE-REASON). The Reset button sits directly beside the submit button, so it is 3 (FORMS-RESET-BUTTON).
